text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer watched Nakayama Festa run. 
She was still developing. Setting the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe as her ceiling left 
far too much untapped potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suggest using the Classic Triple Crown— 
the Satsuki Sho, the Japan Derby, and the 
Kikuka Sho— as opportunities for growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, immediately after, she learned of 
an astounding truth. Her former homeroom 
teacher had... less than a year left to 
live. ...Right after promising they would 
take on the world together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, even if she ran in the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe now, she would have zero 
chance of winning. What could she possibly 
do for her mentor? Crushed, she...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Hope keeps people alive." Recalling her 
former homeroom teacher's words, an idea 
for a certain wager came to her mind.
